unit.why: A narrative about two disciples of R. Shneur Zalman who spend Shabbat with R. Aharon of Karlin, fail to show him deference, and are rebuked and taught, ending in an extended homily.

stories.start_quote: פעם אחת שבתו אצל הרב הקדוש
stories.summary_en: Two Chabad disciples spending Shabbat with R. Aharon of Karlin take his hidden ways for simplicity and show him no submission; he grows angry, tests them on a midrash, foresees how they will mock him at home, and teaches through Joseph and Rashi that a man with a holy tongue may speak even in gentile languages on Shabbat.

tags.why: The whole episode takes place at the Shabbat meal.

quotes: שני אנשים מתלמידי הרב הקדוש מוה׳ זלמינא
tags.why: Disciples of R. Shneur Zalman stay with another tsaddik.

quotes: אתם שנקראים בפי כל העולם חב״ד ניקיש
ובעת סעודת שבת הושיבם קרוב אצלו
וצוה תיכף להביא לפניו מדרש והראה להם
tags.why: He hosts the visitors at his table and tests them.
The rebbe is angered by their lack of deference.

quotes: לא הראו שום הכנעה לפני הרב הקדוש
tags.why: Their lack of submission is the issue, and the rebbe hides his deeds.
The visitors are exposed when they cannot answer.

quotes: וכל פעולותיו ביחודים היו רק בהסתר גדול
tags.why: The rebbe performs yihudim in secret.

quotes: לשמוע ממנו דברי תורה בסודות נוראות
tags.why: The Chabad disciples are used to esoteric teachings.
He knows their thoughts and what they will say.

quotes: ואוכל הרבה ושותה הרבה זולל וסובא
tags.why: His eating and drinking at the meal is what the visitors will mock.

quotes: אתם ת״ח ואתם לומדים התורה או לאו
כי הנה רשי הש״י ז״ל פי׳ על הפסוק
שהאיש שיש לו לשון קדוש מותר לדבר
tags.why: Exegesis of Gen. 45 and of Rashi delivered by the rebbe.

quotes: מותר לדבר אף בלשונות העמים בשבת
tags.why: Whether one may speak profane or gentile languages on Shabbat.
The narrative ends in an extended homiletic justification.

missing_concepts: hiddenness of a tsaddik's deeds (concealment of holiness)
speech / profane language on Shabbat (holiness of the tongue)
Karlin vs Chabad styles of worship
